test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some blankets are scarves.

II. All rooms are a blanket.

**Conclusions:**

(i) Some scarves are blankets.

(ii) Some rooms are scarves.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/323c20424558fb98454ab19bf6a9ada914ae0453e68de17054fa84c7059a71f4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e9c2389e3e361c05a20849bc2ba6091480882f2a39a0bc835f7e08d995b23a98.png] 

Conclusions:

i) Some scarves are blankets → Follow (As some blankets are scarves. As some part of blankets is common with scarves, therefore it is true.)

ii) Some rooms are scarves → **Does not **follow (As some blankets are scarves and all rooms are a blanket. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (i) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
